subject: pclxs: weak refs (sv_rvweaken/SvWEAKREF) — ADR first, then Clone + FieldHash
description: Head of the A-grind queue (docs/plan.md). Measured: Clone propagates weakness (SvWEAKREF on an incoming ref → sv_rvweaken on the clone it builds); FieldHash weakens a fresh newRV_inc as a magic trigger. Two boundary directions: import ("is this host ref weak?" — scalar_flags bit or new entry) and export ("make this host ref weak" — host callback). Plan flags these as B-tier in A clothing: a host question about weak references. ADR (D11) before code; check what the current vtable can already say (D5/D7/D9 precedent). refhost counts the ref→referent edge since session 8, so real weak semantics (ref becomes undef on referent death) may be conformance-testable. Runtime refusal (R5 shape) when the host lacks the capability, like perl's "weak references are not implemented".
